caption: The drawing features an abstract, repeating floral and foliage pattern composed of irregular, curved shapes in a variety of colors. The objects include stylized leaves, flowers, and organic forms, arranged so that pink, yellow, green, blue, brown, black, and flesh-toned areas interlock and overlap across the design. The background is off-white, and the image has a border where a few of the elements extend slightly beyond the main area, particularly along the top and left edges. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a row of seven rectangular color swatches corresponding to the primary shades used in the design: yellow, brown, pink, flesh, green, blue, and black. The composition is dense with forms, leaving some negative space around the motifs, and the colors appear in flat, unblended sections, making the shapes and lines distinct.
title: Colcha
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
